scripts.dev: concurrently -n BE,FE -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w apps/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w apps/backend && npm run build -w apps/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:unit: npm run build -w shared && jest --config jest.config.js --runInBand
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/backend && npm run typecheck -w apps/frontend
